# Draft:Conference of Presidents of Negro Land Grant Colleges

Conference of Presidents of Negro Land Grant Colleges (1923-1955) was an organization of land grant colleges in the United States. It conferences were attended by presidents of the member colleges.
Clyde Lynn Orr's An analytical study of the Conference of Presidents of Negro Land-Grant Colleges was published in Lexington, Kentucky in 1959
